name: Open Graph Tag Generator
description: Generate complete Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags for website, article, or product pages, with image-dimension hints for rich social previews.

faq.question: How is this different from the Meta Tag Generator?
faq.answer: The Meta Tag Generator covers the basics every page needs (title, description, canonical URL, simple Open Graph tags). This tool goes deeper into the Open Graph protocol specifically: content-type-specific fields (an article's author and publish date, a product's price and currency), image dimensions, locale, and a selectable Twitter Card type — useful once you're optimizing how a specific piece of content previews when shared, not just covering baseline SEO.

faq.question: Why do image width and height matter?
faq.answer: Social platforms use the declared og:image:width/height to lay out the preview card before fetching the image, so a missing or wrong size can mean a slower or broken-looking preview. Roughly 1.91:1 (e.g. 1200×630) is the widely recommended ratio for a large-image preview card.
